note: Every number printed inside a figure (annotations, labels), with its source tag (paper/CONVENTIONS.md). Tick labels and axis limits are not listed, except the T(x) tick labels of Fig. 1a. pb_k_edge.meaning: Pb K-edge energy (reference marker; = defs.yaml pb_k_edge)

cs137_line.meaning: Cs-137 line, marked at 661.7 keV (defs.yaml cs137_line = 661.657)

co60_mean.meaning: mean of the Co-60 lines (defs.yaml co60_lines), the single Co-60 marker

identity_one.meaning: transmission 1 at the front face (Fig. 1a); x = 1, headline thickness (Fig. S3)

T_target.meaning: transmission target 0.01 (Fig. 1a T(x) curve; = defs.yaml T_target)

ehull_bins.meaning: Phase 3 e_hull bins (not drawn in Phase 4c)

excl_display_threshold.meaning: Fig. S2 shows elements whose exclusion price reaches >= 2 % somewhere

amb_icsd_min.meaning: fully oxidised filter: at least 3 ICSD entries (revision E5)

mc_ci_z.meaning: Monte Carlo statistical interval ± 1.96 SE (= defs.yaml mc_ci_z)
